core_rule: Thank every legitimate human correspondent who provides feedback and recognize useful feedback with a governed reward.
eligible: A real person who submits sincere product, delivery, accessibility, audio, checkout, or customer-experience feedback.
A real person whose report identifies a reproducible defect, safety concern, confusing experience, or useful improvement.
excluded: abusive, threatening, or deliberately disruptive submissions
required_actions: Acknowledge and thank the eligible correspondent.
Record the feedback and its resulting action or decision.
Do not promise or issue a reward until the reward type, value, eligibility proof, and fulfillment controls are approved.
